label: Type mapping (Search)
type: controls which documents are included/excluded from a Search index, based on document type. Can be static or dynamic (search:dynamic-mapping).
evidence: Create a type mapping with the Couchbase Server Web Console to control what documents are included or excluded from a Search index.
(Optional) To switch from a dynamic type mapping to a static type mapping, select Only index specified fields.
relates_to_competency_question: How does a Search index decide which documents belong to it in the first place?
